name: Jmaxxz
biography: Jmaxxz works as a software engineer, but is a hacker by passion. He is best known for his work on the August Smart Lock (DEF CON 24 “Backdooring the Frontdoor”). In recent years IoT devices have been the focus of his work. He participated in the IoT village zero day track at DEF CON 24 and DEF CON 25. After enduring several polar vortexes, he decided it was probably time to investigate an IoT remote car starter. twitter: @jmaxxz Website: jmaxxz.com
